description: Enhanced Non-Blocking Agent Execution with AI-powered improvements. Prevents "agent stopped responding / stuck / no output" failures in sandboxed agent runtimes (Arena Agent Mode, OpenClaw, Codex) where a single long tool call blocks the turn and stdin is closed so interactive prompts hang forever. NEW in v2.0.0: - Full jobctl.sh implementation with all commands - Multi-model compatibility (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq, etc.) - Token usage optimization and monitoring - Hallucination reduction via verification - Self-improving through feedback loops - Comprehensive debugging and logging - Idempotent operations and graceful error handling - Watchdog timers for timeout protection - Callback URL support for async notifications - Durable state persistence across turns Provides the detach → bounded-poll → durable-state pattern plus a ready-to-use jobctl.sh runner with enhanced features for production use.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent gather relevant evidence before concluding?
